options.text: Two heads is a case of at least one head, so its chance cannot be larger.

explain.text: Two heads implies at least one head, so the first event is a subset of the second. Monotonicity gives $P(\text{two heads}) \le P(\text{at least one head})$. Here $0.8 > 0.75$, so the model breaks it.
